entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai! And...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...Akechi-san?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We just happened to be together[n]when he got your call.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: First a dead woman returns, and now[n]a Palace appears... How intriguing.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Akechi-san, you know about Palaces?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Would it help you grasp the situation if[n]I told you that I have the same powers[n]he has?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Really!? Does that mean you're also...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Allow me to stop you there—I'm not[n]a part of the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, since you've already grasped[n]the concept, it's clear to me that you're[n]a fellow Persona-user.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um...
You can tell him.
He knows.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes, I can use a Persona as well. I'm not[n]a part of the Phantom Thieves either,[n]though...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I just so happened to slip into this[n]Palace with [lName]-senpai and[n]Morgana-senpai a while ago.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But, what could be the meaning behind[n]its appearance here?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I just happened to be passing by[n]on my way home when I came[n]across it...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Since nobody else is making a scene[n]about it, I assume others aren't able[n]to see it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Or, they see it, but it doesn't evoke any[n]real reaction in them...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes, that's exactly it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I asked some people in the area, and[n]none of them seemed to care at all[n]about its appearance.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hmm... Rather than simply hypothesize[n]out here, we may be better off taking[n]immediate action.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You mean, we should go into the Palace?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Not only has a Palace manifested in[n]reality, but this is the only one visible[n]to us.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I realize I have no proof, but it's highly[n]likely that this is related to our current[n]incomprehensible situation.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Wouldn't it be more efficient to just[n]go inside and see what we can learn?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That is, if we have the means to do so.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, it's...
The Metaverse Navigator icon is back[n]on my home screen...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I thought it was gone for good, but it[n]looks like we've regained access to[n]the Nav.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I have it as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is there a search history?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Search history... How do I check...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ah! There's one search in the log, but...
There's an entry in the search history,[n]but I can't read whose Palace it is...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The "name" portion of the entry has[n]been censored somehow...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Could this be the doing of the Palace's[n]Ruler?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Does that mean we can't enter the[n]Palace?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, we do have the search history,[n]so it should be possible to infiltrate it[n]anyway.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...If you're going in, would you be[n]willing to bring me with you?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I can't put my finger on it, but something's[n]been bothering me about this place[n]ever since we first entered it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I promise I won't slow you down.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What's your call?
Infiltration time.
I guess we're doing this.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: That settles it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: We're going in—together.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All right. Let's do it.
